images.caption: Plymouth : Mayflower Steps The Mayflower Steps are believed to be close to the site in the Barbican area of Plymouth, south-west England, from which the Pilgrim Fathers finally left England aboard the Mayflower, before crossing the Atlantic Ocean to settle in North America on 6 September 1620. The traditional site of their disembarkation in North America is Plymouth Rock.
